name: Arms Control Association
summary: A Washington DC membership organisation, founded in 1971, that works for effective arms control: policy research and issue briefs on nuclear arms control, testing, Iran and North Korea, the journal Arms Control Today, media and congressional engagement, the Physicists Coalition for Nuclear Threat Reduction and convenings of the field's campaigners.
